decisionRule: No candidate unless real in-tree Page.Links producers create material avoidable traversal in this cold template-validation path. IEnumerable alone is not proof; ICollection and LINQ specializations must be accounted for.
criteria: Pin independent baseline, fresh actual upstream default, target history, relevant upstream/fork work, and applicable documentation.
Identify every in-tree Page.Links construction/assignment feeding AssertPagesOk; record concrete collection or iterator shapes, exact static sizes or honest bounds, and null cases.
Trace consumer ownership, lifetime, validation ordering, material observables, side effects, exceptions and null semantics.
If source disqualifies traversal or materiality, retain no code candidate and state native/runtime/performance limits explicitly; no invented deferred or large producers.
Only if a material source-qualified candidate survives, use fresh authorized private graphs and faithful focused native red/green tests under live policy and lease/HOLD gates.
Persist HANDOFF.json, exact empty-or-candidate diff, pinned evidence and SHA256 index; reserved worktree unchanged, all owned native work terminal, comparison count zero.
prohibited: Unrelated finding graph reuse or mutation
